subject.title: BL-ecommerce-coupons: Coupons & Promotions — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should the Coupons & Promotions BL block continue as the owner-approved 28-rule F2 bulk review before any F3/F4 implementation?
rationale: The BL pipeline intentionally makes business-rule validation a human owner decision; current source inspection cannot decide which draft rules are valid business truth.

options.title: Continue the 28-rule F2 block
options.body: MiguelHamelyn validates flags first and then all 28 draft rules before any isolation or tests proceed.

options.title: Split the block before F2 completion
options.body: Maintainers reduce review size but must update the mother issue and branch plan before any implementation work continues.

options.title: Pause until specs are publishable
options.body: The local draft branch or draft PR is made visible first so reviewers can inspect the F1 output before F2 resumes.

recommendation.title: Continue the 28-rule F2 block
recommendation.body: MiguelHamelyn validates flags first and then all 28 draft rules before any isolation or tests proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the named owner, assignee, and author of the main merged coupon feature history.
